verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business docs explicitly offer call forwarding and call routing from the dashboard (docs-18, docs-13). Incoming calls can ring multiple numbers at once or roll to other numbers when unanswered (docs-16), and the mobile app lets users answer business calls from anywhere (docs-19). This directly covers forwarding the business number to a cell when the team is away. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that forwarding to a cell works, and detail on schedule-based or away-mode forwarding.
